takeaways: The general ledger is each legal entity's single, balanced record of debit and credit entries, built on a chart of accounts, fiscal calendar and accounting currency.
Financial dimensions and account structures add business detail such as department or cost center without multiplying main accounts.
Subledgers keep operational detail while posting profiles and vouchers connect every ledger amount back to its source document.
hook: Spreadsheets for sales, bills and payroll rarely agree on a simple question like how much cash the company has. This episode explains the general ledger in Dynamics 365 Finance in plain English for anyone new to finance systems. You learn how accounts, dimensions, subledgers and vouchers turn everyday transactions into a record finance can trust and trace.
